name: hxn-gpu-webgl2
description: WebGL2 for Haxe in the browser, on hxcpp and Ash compiled to wasm: buffers, textures, samplers, programs, vertex arrays and framebuffers
releasenote: In a threaded hxcpp build WebGL2 runs in a browser agent, as under Ash, and await works on what the browser settles. Needs hxn 0.3.6.
